blocks.text: good has been hidden for him in it. Firmly believing in Taqdir in this way is the most excellent means of giving protection to Iman and giving the heart peace from the whisperings of Shaytan.

blocks.narrator: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As (RA)
blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرِ و بْنِ الْعَاصِ ﵄ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: كَتَبَ اللهُ مَقَادِيرَ الْخَلَائِقِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْلُقَ السَّموَاتِ وَاْلاَرْضَ بِخَمْسِينَ اَلْفَ سَنَةٍ قَالَ: وَعَرْشُهُ عَلَي الْمَاءِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب حجاج ادم وموسي صلي الله عليهما وسلم رقم:٦٧٤٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “Fifty thousand years before creating the heavens and the earth, Allah wrote the decrees of all creatures. At that time the Arsh of Allah was upon the water.” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ إِنَّ اللهَ : فَرَغَ إِلَي كُلِّ عَبْدٍ مِّنْ خَلْقِهِ مِنْ خَمْسٍ مِنْ أَجَلِهِ وَعَمَلِهِ وَمَضْجَعِهِ وَاَثَرِهِ وَرِزْقِهِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Allah has decided (the following) five things for every slave: 1. the time of his death, 2. his (good and bad) deeds, 3. his place of stay, 4. the effects that will result from him, 5. his provisions,” said the Prophet ﷺ. Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) narrates this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَمْرِ و بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: لَايُؤْمِنُ الْمَرْءُ حَتَّي يُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدْرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Until he believes that all the good and bad that befalls him happens according to the plan (of Allah)
